description.zh: 播流所属应用名称。您可在[流管理](~~197397~~)页面查看AppName。
description.en: The application name. You can view the `AppName` on the [Stream Management](~~197397~~) page.

description.zh:
><notice>当使用按格式配置功能，即传入 RecordFormat 参数时，此参数无效，可不传></notice>
是否开启自动合并。取值：

- **ON**：开启。如果取值为ON，必须同时设置请求参数ComposeVodTranscodeGroupId。
description.en:
><notice>This parameter is ignored if the `RecordFormat` parameter is specified.></notice>
Specifies whether to enable automatic composition. Valid values:

- **ON**: Enables automatic composition. If you set this value to ON, you must also specify the `ComposeVodTranscodeGroupId` parameter.

description.zh:
><notice>当使用按格式配置功能，即传入 RecordFormat 参数时，此参数无效，可不传></notice>
对自动合成出来的新视频在点播服务中进行一次转码，所使用的点播转码模板组ID。

> 通过 [查询转码配置列表](~~454928~~) 获取
description.en:
><notice>This parameter is ignored if the `RecordFormat` parameter is specified.></notice>
The ID of the ApsaraVideo for VOD transcoding template group used to transcode the video after automatic composition.

> You can get the ID by calling the [Query Transcoding Configuration List](~~454928~~) operation.
The duration of each cyclical recording file, in seconds. Default value: **3600**. Valid values: **300** to **21600**.

description.zh: 断流拼接时长， 直播断流时长超过设定的拼接时长后，将会生成新文件，断流拼接时长支持 15~21600 秒。
description.en: The maximum duration of a stream interruption, in seconds. If a stream interruption exceeds this duration, the system generates a new file. Valid values: 15 to 21600.

description.zh:
按需录制，取值：

- **0**（默认值）：关闭。

- **1**：通过HTTP回调方式。

- **2**：通过解析推流参数触发录制。

- **7**：手动录制，默认不录制，可以通过[RealTimeRecordCommand](~~2847882~~)接口手动控制录制开启或停止。
description.en:
The on-demand recording mode. Valid values:

- **0** (default): Disables on-demand recording.

- **1**: Enables on-demand recording triggered by an HTTP callback.

- **2**: Triggers recording by parsing push streaming parameters.

- **7**: Manual recording. Call the [RealTimeRecordCommand](~~2847882~~) operation to start or stop recording.

description.zh: 按格式配置录制参数列表
description.en: A list of parameters for each recording format.

description.zh:
自动合并，设置为 ON 表示开启自动合并。取值：

- ON，开启自动合并

- OFF，关闭自动合并
description.en:
Specifies whether to enable automatic composition. Valid values:

- `ON`: Enables automatic composition.

- `OFF`: Disables automatic composition.

description.zh:
视频处理方式。取值：

- transcode，使用转码模版组处理视频

- workflow，使用工作流处理视频
description.en:
The video processing method. Valid values:

- `transcode`: Processes the video by using a transcoding template group.

- `workflow`: Processes the video by using a workflow.

description.zh:
视频处理转码模版组 Id 或工作流模版 Id
> 此处传入的 Id 必须与 ProcessMethod 传入的视频处理方式对应，即 ProcessMethod 传入 transcode，此处应使用转码模版组 Id
> -
description.en:
The ID of the transcoding template group or workflow.

> ## The ID must match the video processing method specified in ProcessMethod. For example, if ProcessMethod is set to transcode, you must use a transcoding template group ID.

description.zh:
单个切片时长，单位：秒
><notice>当 RecordFormat.N.Format（格式）设为 m3u8 时，本参数才有效。></notice>
不填则默认为 30 秒。取值范围：5s~30s。
description.en:
The duration of each segment, in seconds.
><notice>This parameter applies only to the `m3u8` format.></notice>
The default value is 30. Valid values: 5 to 30.

description.zh:
视频处理源。取值：

- origin(默认值)，处理源视频

- compose，处理合并后视频

如需同时处理源视频和合并后视频，请将两个取值同时传入,以","分隔，如 origin,compose
description.en:
The video source to process. Valid values:

- `origin` (default): Processes the source video.

- `compose`: Processes the composed video.

To process both the source and composed videos, separate the values with a comma. For example, `origin,compose`.

description.zh: 播流名称。您可在[流管理](~~197397~~)页面查看StreamName。
description.en: The stream name. You can view the `StreamName` on the [Stream Management](~~197397~~) page.

description.zh:
><notice>当使用按格式配置功能，即传入 RecordFormat 参数时，此参数无效，可不传></notice>
点播转码模板组ID。
description.en: ><notice>This parameter is ignored if the `RecordFormat` parameter is specified.></notice> The ID of the ApsaraVideo for VOD transcoding template group.

title.zh: 更新直播录制转点播配置

descriptions.zh: 本接口的单用户QPS限制为1000次/分钟。超过限制，API调用会被限流，这可能会影响您的业务，请合理调用。
descriptions.en: This operation has a rate limit of 1,000 calls per minute per account. If you exceed this limit, your API calls will be rate-limited, which may interrupt your service.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun live update-live-record-vod-config --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --domain-name example.com --app-name testName --stream-name stream --vod-transcode-group-id e2d796d3bb5fd8049d32bff62f940000 --cycle-duration 300 --auto-compose OFF --compose-vod-transcode-group-id 00000 --on-demand 0 --delay-time 180 --record-format Format=m3u8 AutoCompose=ON VideoProcess=origin SliceDuration=30 ProcessMethod=transcode ProcessTemplateId=e2d796d3bb5fd8049d32bff62f940000 Tags=sports --transcode-templates sd --region cn-hangzhou
